workflow.source: short original cat story, two panels
workflow.observation: Both panels generated automatically. Visual review triggered selective redraw. One later generation timed out; one explicit resume retained the passed panel and reached the bounded human-revision gate. No fake JSON reply or placeholder art used.

unit_test_isolation: Provider defaults are fixed in pytest; real native invocation and non-mocked provider HTTP are blocked. An earlier suite inherited the local image mode and was terminated; its outputs are not counted as planned live validation.
limits: No independent art-quality gain, clean-machine first OAuth success rate, global timing speedup or cost reduction measured. New users must complete their own sign-in and capability tests.
